notes.title: Welcome to FPVSIM V2
notes.content:
FPVSIM V2 offers more maps and features, but at a lower price! Main updates:

[list]
[*] A fully revamped quadrotor dynamics simulation engine with realistic propeller and motor simulations, pushing simulation accuracy to the next level
[*] Added Level mode on top of Acro/Angle mode, great for beginners
[*] Added 6 brand new maps, making a total offering of 15 maps! Some of them are specifically tailored for medium to lower end PCs. New maps are:
[*] Asian Medieval Town
[*] Drifting Scene: a frequently asked feature, now added to the portfolio
[*] City Park
[*] Harbor Party
[*] Desert Track
[*] Secret Base
[*] Added toggleable realtime stick overlay, make it it easier to see how certain tricks are done
[*] Added throttle limit configurations, allowing you to configure throttle limit in the sim
[*] Added max deg/s to rate configurator, making it easier to see the current rate
[*] Auto hide and show floating buttons and cursor: move or left click the mouse to reveal
[*] Add altitude and flight mode info to HUD
[*] New inflatable FPV gate model
[*] New feature flag model
[*] Fine tuned propeller sound
[*] Polish HUD and loading screen
[*] Add instructions for car driving scene
[*] Fixed a bug where updating drone settings occasionally crashes the game
[*] etc.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for April 2024
notes.content: Featuring a fully revamped controller/joystick input system that provides support for a wider range of controllers including DJI controllers.

notes.title: Introducing FPVSIM Car driving experience
notes.content: * Introducing a new scene where you can drive cars in the City map. Use Throttle + Yaw axis to control the car.

notes.title: Location bookmarks in GoogleMaps scene & Better gamepad support
notes.content:
* Allow bookmarking custom locations in GoogleMaps scene. Now you can have a list of your faviorite locations while wandering the earth :)
* Add half range throttle support for better gamepad gameplay experiences
* Tuned down the default speed by 20%. You can still increase it in the drone config screen.

Thanks for the feedbacks from players! We take everyone of them seriously! Happy holidays!
